title: Alignment and Foundation
description: Set the foundation for career management: agree the strategy and governance guidelines, and map the stakeholders who must be involved.
prompt: What should the career management strategy commit us to, and which stakeholders must be on board first?

deliverables.t: Career Management strategy and governance guidelines

title: Design Career Possibilities
description: Define the range of career moves open to employees and show them in a framework and visual career maps.
prompt: What career paths should employees be able to see, including moves sideways and across functions?

title: Introduce Formal Career Conversation Cycle
description: Introduce a regular career conversation between employees and managers, with the guide, toolkit and training to support it.
prompt: What should a good career conversation cover, and what support do managers need to hold one?

title: Establish Stretch Assignment Program
description: Set up a programme of stretch assignments, with clear governance guidelines.
prompt: What kinds of stretch assignments could we offer, and how should people be chosen for them?

title: Introduce Career Advisory Service: enablement and communication
description: Launch the Career Advisory Service and keep supporting it with enablement and communication. This is an ongoing task.
prompt: How should we tell people about the service, and what help do they need to use it?

title: Monitoring, Feedback and Continuous Improvement
description: Collect feedback and keep improving the programme, supported by guides, FAQs and a career portal.
prompt: How will we know the programme is working, and what should we change first?

title: Alignment and Foundation
description: Set the foundation for succession management: agree the charter that governs it and identify the critical roles it covers.
prompt: What should the succession management charter commit us to, and what makes a role critical here?

title: Apply the succession plan nomination procedure
description: Put the nomination procedure into practice and produce the first list of nominees.
prompt: Who should be able to nominate, and how do we keep nominations fair and confidential?

title: Assessment and Talent Identification
description: Assess the nominees and place the candidates on the 9-box grid.
prompt: What evidence should we use to judge performance and potential, and who should review the results?

title: Program Rollout and Track Delivery
description: Roll out development for the identified talent, using a curriculum tailored to the leadership pipeline.
prompt: Which development experiences would prepare our successors best, and what do they need first?

deliverables.t: Tailored leadership development curriculum and solutions

title: Metric Review and Monitoring
description: Track the health of the leadership pipeline and audit how succession management is working.
prompt: Which risk measures would tell us early that the pipeline is weak?
